description: Track along the second skeleton, feet to head
vo_text: Physical analysis has already identified a mismatched head and torso. Now genetics establishes that this second body also contains remains from at least three people.

description: Crane up from both graves to the whole house floor at dusk
vo_text: Under one house, the team has found two assembled bodies containing parts from at least six individuals.

description: The roundhouses at dusk: six lives
vo_text: But those six lives still don’t explain how the bodies ended up there.

description: Close from above: the uppermost left leg ends in dry breaks where the knee should be
vo_text: The second skeleton is missing part of its left knee. The break is below the other leg, which lies across it. Whoever placed the body in the grave arranged the right leg over a left leg that was already incomplete.

description: The legs in the grave from the other side, slow slider
vo_text: That helps establish an order. The knee went missing before this burial. Taking it out afterward would have disturbed the bones above it.

description: Macro: a dry, chalky fracture face in grazing light
vo_text: The fractures tell the team something else. These bones broke after they had lost much of the collagen that gives fresh bone its flexibility. By then, the person had been dead for a considerable time.

description: A dried, wrapped body on a hurdle in the dim roundhouse
